stop.text: Stop there. You've {bounty} gold on your head in {region}. Pay it, and hand over what you took, or you're coming with me.

choices.text: There's been a mistake. I've never seen that purse in my life.

not_buying.text: Save it. I've heard that one from better liars. Pay, or the cells.

talked.text: ...Fine. Maybe I've got the wrong face. Keep your nose clean.

paid.text: That settles it. Don't let me catch you at it again.
